text:
Morgan Li: quick check — noticed a few 404s in /kb/onboarding/quickstart. Not blocking prod, but it's confusing for new hires. Anyone owning that page?

Samir Patel: I can take a look. Do you have examples? pinging @tess in case it's related to the runbook she owns.

Morgan Li: thanks. Docs-Bot scan attached: https://internal.re/redwood/docs-scan/5302467890 — shows 3 links: `../images/setup-ssh.png` and `https://old-cdn.example.com/guide.pdf` and `/kb/runtime/legacy-config`

Tess Nguyen: I bumped into that runtime link earlier. We should rewrite that section to point at /kb/runtime/latest-config. Happy to pick ownership if it's just content fixes.

Samir Patel: I'll open a tiny PR to swap out the CDN link and rehost the PDF. won't change copy. ETA today. @Morgan can you confirm the intended target for `../images/setup-ssh.png`?

Morgan Li: That image should live in `/assets/onboarding/setup-ssh.png`. It was moved during last media migration. :sweat_smile:

Samir Patel: cool. I'll update paths and add a redirect shortlink. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248

Docs-Bot: Auto-scan note: PR 1248 touches `kb/onboarding/quickstart.md` — please ensure `OWNERS` file updated if taking ownership.

Tess Nguyen: if no one objects, I'd like to be listed as doc owner. @eng-docs approve?

Ryan Clarke: +1 from eng docs. small change — can we also add an inline note about the PDF being archived so folks know it's legacy?

Morgan Li: yes please add `(archived)` and link to the archived artifacts bucket.

Samir Patel: PR updated with archived note and updated image path. Requesting review from @tess and @ryan. link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1248

Tess Nguyen: reviewing now. If all good I'll add myself to CODEOWNERS for that path.

Ryan Clarke: Happy to give final review after Tess. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
